easyPrerequisites: Sunstrike Legionnaire does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Cast Icewind Stalwart by paying its mana cost.
When Icewind Stalwart enters, it and Sunstrike Legionnaire trigger.
Resolve the Sunstrike Legionnaire trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Kirol by tapping it and Sunstrike Legionnaire. copying Icewind Stalwart's trigger, targeting Kirol.
Resolve the copy of Icewind Stalwart's trigger, blinking Kirol.
When Kirol enters, Sunstrike Legionnaire triggers, untapping Sunstrike Legionnaire.
Repeat from step 4.
